title: Smoky Filipino Pappardelle
description: A fusion of Filipino and Italian flavors, this recipe combines the smokiness of grilled meats with the creaminess of a Filipino-inspired sauce.
instructions: 2. Grill pork shoulder for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
3. Crumble bacon and cook in a pan over medium heat until crispy.
4. Add sliced onion to the pan and cook until softened.
5. Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
6. Stir in fish sauce, coconut milk, and sambal oelek (if using).
7. Bring sauce to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until slightly thickened.
8. Cook pappardelle according to package instructions.
9. Slice grilled pork shoulder into thin strips.
10. Serve pappardelle with sliced pork, bacon, and sauce.
11. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
